maddeler.e:
نتشاغل (form VI)
# نَتَشَاغَلُ (natašāḡalu) /na.ta.ʃaː.ɣa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
# نَتَشَاغَلَ (natašāḡala) /na.ta.ʃaː.ɣa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
# نَتَشَاغَلْ (natašāḡal) /na.ta.ʃaː.ɣal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
